trans-unit.source: Structured data of the shop as JSON-LD. Covers the identity of the Organization and the return and shipping conditions of the Organization and Offer markup.
trans-unit.target: Structured data of the shop as JSON-LD. Covers the identity of the Organization and the return and shipping conditions of the Organization and Offer markup.

trans-unit.source: Enter the website address with https://, e.g. https://example.com.
trans-unit.target: Enter the website address with https://, e.g. https://example.com.

trans-unit.source: Enter the full logo address, starting with https://.
trans-unit.target: Enter the full logo address, starting with https://.

trans-unit.source: Enter one full address per line, starting with https://.
trans-unit.target: Enter one full address per line, starting with https://.

trans-unit.source: Days must be whole numbers, 0 or more.
trans-unit.target: Days must be whole numbers, 0 or more.

trans-unit.source: Amounts must be numbers, 0 or more.
trans-unit.target: Amounts must be numbers, 0 or more.

trans-unit.source: The return window must be at least 1 day.
trans-unit.target: The return window must be at least 1 day.

trans-unit.source: A minimum cannot be greater than its maximum.
trans-unit.target: A minimum cannot be greater than its maximum.

trans-unit.source: Select at least one country for returns.
trans-unit.target: Select at least one country for returns.

trans-unit.source: Google accepts at most 50 countries for returns.
trans-unit.target: Google accepts at most 50 countries for returns.

trans-unit.source: Who runs the shop, as search engines and AI assistants should see it. Fill in only when it differs from the shop: e.g. a demo or a brand shop of a larger company.
trans-unit.target: Who runs the shop, as search engines and AI assistants should see it. Fill in only when it differs from the shop: e.g. a demo or a brand shop of a larger company.

trans-unit.source: The main website of the organization. Use the same address on every site of the organization, so search engines treat them as one. Empty: this shop.
trans-unit.target: The main website of the organization. Use the same address on every site of the organization, so search engines treat them as one. Empty: this shop.

trans-unit.source: Full address of the logo file (PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG), the same as on the organization's website. Empty: the shop logo.
trans-unit.target: Full address of the logo file (PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG), the same as on the organization's website. Empty: the shop logo.

trans-unit.source: One address per line: GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook, the company register.
trans-unit.target: One address per line: GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook, the company register.

trans-unit.source: Add the policies to the structured data
trans-unit.target: Add the policies to the structured data

trans-unit.source: Organization markup on the home page, Offer markup on product pages.
trans-unit.target: Organization markup on the home page, Offer markup on product pages.

trans-unit.source: Paid by the customer. 0 means free returns.

trans-unit.source: Countries the return policy applies to
trans-unit.target: Countries the return policy applies to

trans-unit.target: Empty: the threshold of the free delivery module (now %amount%). 0 turns free shipping off in the markup.

trans-unit.source: Business days from the order to dispatch.

trans-unit.target: Business days from dispatch to delivery.
